builtin.001.title: COM classes
builtin.001.description: COM class registrations indexed by CLSID. This merged view can include user and machine registrations; inspect the origin before editing.
builtin.002.title: COM class registration
builtin.002.description: Contains server, ProgID and related metadata for a class identifier. Registration alone does not establish that its server exists or is trusted.
builtin.003.title: In-process COM server
builtin.003.description: Path to a COM DLL loaded into the calling process; inspect existence and signature.
builtin.004.title: In-process COM server value
builtin.004.description: Path to a COM DLL loaded into the calling process; inspect existence and signature.
builtin.005.title: Out-of-process COM server
builtin.005.description: Command for a COM server in another process; distinguish the executable path from its arguments.
builtin.006.title: Out-of-process COM server value
builtin.006.description: Command for a COM server in another process; distinguish the executable path from its arguments.
builtin.007.title: COM ProgID
builtin.007.description: Version-specific programmatic identifier associated with this CLSID.
builtin.008.title: COM ProgID value
builtin.008.description: Version-specific programmatic identifier associated with this CLSID.
builtin.009.title: Version-independent ProgID
builtin.009.description: Connects the class to a programmatic identifier that is independent of a particular version.
builtin.010.title: Version-independent ProgID value
builtin.010.description: Connects the class to a programmatic identifier that is independent of a particular version.
builtin.011.title: Replacement COM class
builtin.011.description: References a replacement CLSID for activation; inspect the chain and any cycles.
builtin.012.title: Replacement COM class value
builtin.012.description: References a replacement CLSID for activation; inspect the chain and any cycles.
builtin.013.title: Automatic replacement class
builtin.013.description: Specifies a replacement CLSID used for automatic conversion.
builtin.014.title: Automatic replacement class value
builtin.014.description: Specifies a replacement CLSID used for automatic conversion.
builtin.015.title: COM type library
builtin.015.description: Identifier of the type library associated with this class.
builtin.016.title: COM type library value
builtin.016.description: Identifier of the type library associated with this class.
builtin.017.title: COM type version
builtin.017.description: Version information for the associated type information.
builtin.018.title: COM type version value
builtin.018.description: Version information for the associated type information.
builtin.019.title: Class icon
builtin.019.description: Icon file and resource location for the class; a number after a comma can be a resource selector.
builtin.020.title: Class icon value
builtin.020.description: Icon file and resource location for the class; a number after a comma can be a resource selector.
builtin.021.title: COM application link
builtin.021.description: Registration linking the class with COM application settings.
builtin.022.title: COM application link value
builtin.022.description: Registration linking the class with COM application settings.
builtin.023.title: Implemented COM categories
builtin.023.description: Lists component categories that this class is registered as implementing.
builtin.024.title: Required COM categories
builtin.024.description: Lists component categories required by the class.
builtin.025.title: COM handler
builtin.025.description: Registration of an in-process handler DLL for a COM object.
builtin.026.title: COM handler value
builtin.026.description: Registration of an in-process handler DLL for a COM object.
builtin.027.title: Insertable object
builtin.027.description: Registration marker indicating that an object can be inserted into a containing document.
builtin.028.title: ActiveX control
builtin.028.description: Marks a class as a control; this marker does not establish that it is safe.
builtin.029.title: Toolbox bitmap
builtin.029.description: Bitmap resource used by a development-tool toolbox.
builtin.030.title: Toolbox bitmap value
builtin.030.description: Bitmap resource used by a development-tool toolbox.
builtin.031.title: COM threading model
builtin.031.description: Threading model of an in-process COM server; it must agree with the server implementation.
builtin.032.title: COM AppID reference
builtin.032.description: References the AppID governing this COM application.
builtin.033.title: File extension
builtin.033.description: Connects an extension with a ProgID, content type and open-with candidates.
builtin.034.title: Extension ProgID
builtin.034.description: References a file-type ProgID. A user choice can override the effective default application.
builtin.035.title: MIME type
builtin.035.description: MIME content type associated with the extension.
builtin.036.title: Perceived type
builtin.036.description: Broad classification of the file type, such as image or audio.
builtin.037.title: Open-with ProgIDs
builtin.037.description: Lists ProgIDs registered as open-with candidates; this does not force the default application.
builtin.038.title: Open-with applications
builtin.038.description: Application registrations offered as open-with candidates for the extension.
builtin.039.title: File-type verbs
builtin.039.description: Contains shell verbs such as open, edit and print.
builtin.040.title: Default verb name
builtin.040.description: Name of the preferred shell verb for this file type.
builtin.041.title: Shell verb
builtin.041.description: Display name and invocation settings for one shell verb.
builtin.042.title: Shell command
builtin.042.description: Contains the command invoked by a shell verb; inspect argument placeholders and quoting.
builtin.043.title: Command string
builtin.043.description: Command string that can contain file argument placeholders; inspecting it does not execute it.
builtin.044.title: COM execution delegate
builtin.044.description: CLSID of the COM object delegated to execute the verb.
builtin.045.title: Localized verb name
builtin.045.description: Name or indirect resource string displayed for the verb.
builtin.046.title: Verb icon
builtin.046.description: Icon file and resource location for a shell verb.
builtin.047.title: Extended verb
builtin.047.description: Marker for a verb shown in an extended context menu.
builtin.048.title: Legacy verb disable marker
builtin.048.description: Marker that suppresses a legacy registered verb without deleting its registration.
builtin.049.title: File-type icon
builtin.049.description: Location of the default icon for a file type.
builtin.050.title: Current ProgID version
builtin.050.description: Links a version-independent ProgID to its current version.
builtin.051.title: Registered applications
builtin.051.description: Application registrations by executable name used by shell file associations.
builtin.052.title: Application association metadata
builtin.052.description: Contains an application's display name, shell verbs and supported types.
builtin.053.title: Supported extensions
builtin.053.description: Extensions registered as supported by an application.
builtin.054.title: Friendly application name
builtin.054.description: Application name used in open-with and related user interfaces.
builtin.055.title: System file associations
builtin.055.description: Shared shell association settings for extensions or perceived types.
builtin.056.title: MIME content-type registrations
builtin.056.description: Collects MIME content types and their associated extension registrations.

builtin.075.title: Run entries
builtin.075.description: Commands scheduled at logon; entry order does not guarantee execution order.
builtin.076.title: Startup command
builtin.076.description: Program command used for startup; inspect its path, arguments, existence and publisher.
builtin.077.title: RunOnce entries
builtin.077.description: Commands intended for a single logon execution; processing and deletion depend on flags and user privileges.
builtin.078.title: Startup command
builtin.078.description: Program command used for startup; inspect its path, arguments, existence and publisher.
builtin.079.title: Application paths
builtin.079.description: Shell registrations that map executable names to installed paths.
builtin.080.title: Executable registration
builtin.080.description: Specifies an application's executable and additional search path.
builtin.081.title: Application executable
builtin.081.description: Full path of the registered application executable.
builtin.082.title: Application search path
builtin.082.description: Additional search path used when launching this application, separate from the system Path.
builtin.083.title: Installed application registrations
builtin.083.description: Collects display and uninstall metadata for installed applications.
builtin.084.title: Application uninstall metadata
builtin.084.description: Display, version and uninstall metadata; this location is not necessarily a complete inventory of installed applications.
builtin.085.title: Run entries
builtin.085.description: Commands scheduled at logon; entry order does not guarantee execution order.
builtin.086.title: Startup command
builtin.086.description: Program command used for startup; inspect its path, arguments, existence and publisher.
builtin.087.title: RunOnce entries
builtin.087.description: Commands intended for a single logon execution; processing and deletion depend on flags and user privileges.
builtin.088.title: Startup command
builtin.088.description: Program command used for startup; inspect its path, arguments, existence and publisher.
builtin.089.title: Application paths
builtin.089.description: Shell registrations that map executable names to installed paths.
builtin.090.title: Executable registration
builtin.090.description: Specifies an application's executable and additional search path.
builtin.091.title: Application executable
builtin.091.description: Full path of the registered application executable.
builtin.092.title: Application search path
builtin.092.description: Additional search path used when launching this application, separate from the system Path.
builtin.093.title: Installed application registrations
builtin.093.description: Collects display and uninstall metadata for installed applications.
builtin.094.title: Application uninstall metadata
builtin.094.description: Display, version and uninstall metadata; this location is not necessarily a complete inventory of installed applications.
builtin.095.title: Application name
builtin.095.description: Display name recorded by the installer.
builtin.096.title: Display version
builtin.096.description: Installer-supplied version string; it can differ from a binary file version.
builtin.097.title: Publisher
builtin.097.description: Publisher string in installation metadata; it is distinct from signature verification.
builtin.098.title: Uninstall command
builtin.098.description: Command used to uninstall the application; inspection does not execute it.
builtin.099.title: Installation location
builtin.099.description: Application location recorded by the installer.
builtin.100.title: Installed application icon
builtin.100.description: Icon location for the installed-applications listing.
builtin.101.title: Estimated installed size
builtin.101.description: Estimated size recorded by the installer; actual disk usage can differ.
builtin.102.title: User environment
builtin.102.description: Source environment variables for newly created processes; existing processes can retain a different environment.
builtin.103.title: User Program search path
builtin.103.description: Ordered folders used in program or module lookup; editing preserves order and duplicates until explicitly changed.
builtin.104.title: User Temporary-file directory
builtin.104.description: Directory applications can use for temporary files; an application can use its own configuration.
builtin.105.title: User Alternate temporary directory
builtin.105.description: Temporary-directory environment variable consulted by some applications.
builtin.106.title: User Executable extensions
builtin.106.description: Extensions consulted by command processors when locating executable files.
builtin.107.title: System environment
builtin.107.description: Source environment variables for newly created processes; existing processes can retain a different environment.
builtin.108.title: System Program search path
builtin.108.description: Ordered folders used in program or module lookup; editing preserves order and duplicates until explicitly changed.
builtin.109.title: System Temporary-file directory
builtin.109.description: Directory applications can use for temporary files; an application can use its own configuration.
builtin.110.title: System Alternate temporary directory
builtin.110.description: Temporary-directory environment variable consulted by some applications.
builtin.111.title: System Executable extensions
builtin.111.description: Extensions consulted by command processors when locating executable files.
builtin.112.title: Session environment
builtin.112.description: Environment information supplied for a logon session, distinct from persistent variables and the current process environment.
builtin.113.title: Windows logon settings
builtin.113.description: Logon initialization and shell configuration; incorrect changes can prevent the desktop from starting after sign-in.
builtin.114.title: User shell
builtin.114.description: Program launched as the user shell after sign-in. Back up the original and inspect the executable before changing it.
builtin.115.title: User initialization program
builtin.115.description: Program specification used to initialize the user environment during sign-in. Back up the original and inspect the executable before changing it.
builtin.116.title: Services and drivers
builtin.116.description: Service and driver registrations; use the system services view for start and stop operations.
builtin.117.title: Service registration
builtin.117.description: Configuration for a service or driver; a registry edit alone need not immediately change its running state.
builtin.118.title: Service image path
builtin.118.description: Location of the service executable or driver image.
builtin.119.title: Service start type
builtin.119.description: Controls when the system starts a service; interpretation depends on the service or driver type.
builtin.120.title: Service type
builtin.120.description: Bit settings identifying the service or driver type.
builtin.121.title: Startup error handling
builtin.121.description: Specifies how the system handles failure during startup.
builtin.122.title: Service display name
builtin.122.description: Name or indirect resource string displayed in service lists.
builtin.123.title: Service description
builtin.123.description: Registered service description or an indirect resource string.
builtin.124.title: Service account
builtin.124.description: Account name used to run the service; this value does not expose a password or establish effective permissions.
builtin.125.title: Service dependencies
builtin.125.description: Names of services required before this service can start.
builtin.126.title: Service group dependencies
builtin.126.description: Service groups required before this service can start.
builtin.127.title: Service load group
builtin.127.description: Load-order group containing the service or driver.
builtin.128.title: Explorer advanced settings
builtin.128.description: Display and behavior settings for File Explorer; available settings and effective behavior vary with Windows versions and policies.
builtin.129.title: Hidden-item display
builtin.129.description: Display setting for files and folders with the hidden attribute, separate from protected system items.
builtin.130.title: Hide known extensions
builtin.130.description: Controls hiding extensions of known file types in Explorer.
builtin.131.title: Protected system-item display
builtin.131.description: Display setting for protected operating-system files; it does not change their permissions.
builtin.132.title: File information tips
builtin.132.description: Controls information tips shown for items in Explorer.
builtin.133.title: Compressed/encrypted display color
builtin.133.description: Display setting distinguishing compressed or encrypted items; inspect actual file attributes to verify encryption.
builtin.134.title: Hide desktop icons
builtin.134.description: Desktop-icon visibility setting; hiding an icon does not delete its underlying file.
builtin.135.title: Separate Explorer process
builtin.135.description: Explorer setting for opening folder windows in a separate process; actual process placement can vary with version and state.
builtin.136.title: Explorer status bar
builtin.136.description: Controls the visibility of Explorer's status bar.
builtin.137.title: Item-selection check boxes
builtin.137.description: Controls item-selection check boxes in File Explorer.
builtin.138.title: User known folders
builtin.138.description: Paths for known user folders such as Documents and Desktop; consider folder relocation and redirection policies before editing.
builtin.139.title: Desktop folder
builtin.139.description: Path of the user's Desktop folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.140.title: Documents folder
builtin.140.description: Path of the user's Documents folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.141.title: Pictures folder
builtin.141.description: Path of the user's Pictures folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.142.title: Music folder
builtin.142.description: Path of the user's Music folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.143.title: Videos folder
builtin.143.description: Path of the user's Videos folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.144.title: Favorites folder
builtin.144.description: Path of the user's Favorites folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.145.title: Roaming application data folder
builtin.145.description: Path of the user's Roaming application data folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.146.title: Local application data folder
builtin.146.description: Path of the user's Local application data folder; variables in expandable strings depend on the user's environment.
builtin.147.title: Image execution options
builtin.147.description: Per-image debugging and diagnostic configuration; its presence alone does not establish malicious behavior.
builtin.148.title: Per-image options
builtin.148.description: Diagnostic and execution settings for an image name; also inspect any path-specific filters.
builtin.149.title: Image debugger
builtin.149.description: Debugger command used when launching the target image; inspect its path and arguments because it changes the launch flow.
builtin.150.title: Image diagnostic flags
builtin.150.description: Flags enabling per-image diagnostics; individual bits have distinct meanings and can affect performance.
builtin.151.title: Exploit-protection options
builtin.151.description: Stored per-application exploit-protection settings; prefer supported Windows Security controls over editing arbitrary bits.
builtin.152.title: Image tracing flags
builtin.152.description: Tracing configuration for an image; inspect it alongside the supported tracing tools.
